text:
Anna: heads-up — seeing a sudden quota spike for tenant-42 around 03:30 UTC. Console shows most of it as v1 usage but the clients swear they're on v2. (https://console.redwood.example/tenants/42/meters)
Mark: which dashboard exactly? can you paste a sample trace id?
Anna: per-route token-metering + per-model breakdown. sample trace id: trace-20240315-9b7c. lots of 200s, low latency, but attribution column is v1.
Jess: wasn't there a change to header negotiation last week? maybe fallback behavior got stricter.
Mark: I grepped edge logs for the trace id — many requests are missing `x-redwood-api-version`. They hit the default route which is still mapped to v1.
Sam: if that's true we might be billing the wrong API version for a chunk of requests — need to be careful before any spec changes.
Anna: repro is easy with curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` vs same call without `x-redwood-api-version` -> routes to v1 by policy. SDK 2.x normally sets the header; older or custom clients might not.
Priya: console/ux note — our current tenant view only shows resolver-decisions as "explicit header" or "default". We should surface "inferred-from-client" so devs know why fallback happened.
Jess: agreed. UX idea: add a lightweight badge "version inferred (heuristic)" with a hover tooltip listing rules used and an example header.
Mark: short-term mitigation suggestion: edge proxy rule to prefer v2 when UA indicates `RedwoodSDK/2` even if header missing. something like:
```
if headers.get("x-redwood-api-version") is None and headers.get("user-agent", "").contains("RedwoodSDK/2"):
    route = "v2"
```
Anna: would that break any clients that intentionally omit the header? probably low risk — most v2 clients are SDKed. but we should do a dry-run (shadow) first.
Sam: we need to ensure quota attribution doesn't flip retroactively. If we change routing, billing must remain stable for the current billing window unless we reprocess with clear QA.
Priya: console affordance: add an opt-in toggle per-tenant: "Enable implicit version inference (beta)" + an audit log entry and a comparison panel showing metering diffs between explicit vs inferred routing for the last 24h. :eyes:
Jess: I'll mock the toggle in the staging console. copy: "When enabled, Redwood will attempt to infer API version from SDK fingerprints when explicit version header is absent. This is experimental and only affects routing; usage attribution will be shown for review before billing changes." Thoughts?
Mark: sounds good. Plan: 1) implement proxy shadow route to v2 for inferred requests for 24h, 2) collect comparison metrics, 3) surface in console via Priya's panel, 4) if metrics show >95% match, flip the routing rule and notify billing to reconcile attribution.
Sam: add me to the rollout checklist — I'll coordinate any billing backfills and customer comms if we flip behaviour.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge/proxy/implicit-version-shadow -> staging (patch 2.1.4) by @Mark
Anna: thanks — running repro now and will paste more trace ids. if someone can add the console mock I can link the comparison graphs.
Jess: I'll put a staging PR up for the toggle + panel mock by EOD. Priya, can you draft the tooltip content? :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya: on it. I'll include the detection heuristics and the exact UA patterns.
Anna: ok closing loop here — next check-in in ~24h after shadow run. :thumbsup:
